press.rule: fail-closed (lead): a painted region source of a flattened page that survives in the saved file is certain (silent) ONLY when a kept page DRAWS it: the Do, sh, scn/SCN, gs or Tf target of a scope a kept page draws (page content, the content of a drawn form, pattern or Type 3 font), an appearance stream (/AP /N /R /D, state dictionaries included) of an annotation a kept page lists in its own /Annots, or what drawing an object renders along with it (an image /SMask and /Mask, a shading pattern /Shading, a graphics state /SMask /G group). Any other surviving reference (a non-gated /Resources entry of a kept page such as /Properties or /ColorSpace, a plain key of a drawn object such as /Alternates or /PieceInfo, a form that only a plain reference reaches, catalog /AF, /Names, /Dests, trailer roots) is reported as NotProven::PaintedSourceKept; it is never pruned by this change (the kept structure is not edited; prefer-report).
press.code: src/flatten_purge.rs only: Usage::follow() lost its flag and pushes every reference with certain=false; resources() and traverse() follow plain entries and keys through it; read_scope() pushes the named object certain only in a scope a kept page draws (Some(r) if certain => push(r.num, true), otherwise follow) and pushes rendered_with() targets certain; new fns smask_group() (the existing ExtGState /SMask /G lookup, now shared) and rendered_with(); drop_painted_sources() comments. sanitized_save.rs: doc comments only. lib.rs: DESCRIPTOR sentences only.
press.reach_and_pruning_unchanged: `reached` is the same plain-reference closure as at 5606d16 (a Ref target of a certain scope is pushed once with certain=true and its keys are followed plain, as before; a direct target is followed plain), so `gone` and every pruning are unchanged; `certain` of this change is a subset of the old `certain` (draw targets, rendered_with targets and appearance streams were certain before too), so painted_sources_kept can only grow against 5606d16 (fail-closed).
